name: AI Incident Database
caveat: CSETv1 classifies only 214 of 1803 incidents, so its 'no' is weak evidence of absence. The MIT namespace in this export carries no multi-agent value at all and is an older classification run: it never uses subdomain 7.6.

name: MIT AI Risk Navigator
external_ma_field: behaviour facet (UI only, not in the API export)
caveat: Self-declared research prototype, 'preliminary and not yet validated'; asks that its visualizations not be redistributed. Measured 33% false-negative rate against our own incidents. JS app in a cross-origin iframe that frame-busts, so it needs a real browser.

name: Agent Incident Registry (Enkrypt AI)
caveat: Contact Enkrypt before reusing the data. Tagging is incomplete: the Hugging Face swarm is missing from the multi_agent_system view. JS-rendered.

name: AI Agent Incident Register (companyscope)
caveat: Its own ids also use the AIR- prefix, so its records need a distinct source_id namespace. Carries legal analysis and OWASP agentic mapping.

name: LessWrong
caveat: ForumMagnum GraphQL endpoint. A lead source only: every hit must be traced to a primary source before it becomes an incident.

name: AI Alignment Forum
caveat: Same ForumMagnum stack as LessWrong. Lead source only.

name: Effective Altruism Forum
caveat: Same ForumMagnum stack. Lead source only.

name: AI Village operator write-ups
caveat: The Substack copies are reachable where theaidigest.org and X are not. All 7 of our AI Village incidents are absent from AIID entirely.

name: Antimemetics Multi-Agent Databank
caveat: Screened in but not yet recorded: GovSim replication, algorithmic collusion in an LLM duopoly, Prompt Infection.

name: OECD AI Incidents Monitor
caveat: Broad news-based coverage, keyword search only.

name: AIAAIC Repository
caveat: Broad news-based coverage, keyword search only.

name: Moltbook data repository
caveat: Data from the AI-agent social network.

name: Curator write-ups
caveat: Incidents added by hand with `run.py update --manual DIR`: unstructured .txt/.md write-ups by the curator, who vouches for them. In scope on the curator's word (read depth `curator`); a dossier resting on that reading alone is never `verified`.

name: Hammond et al. 2025, Multi-Agent Risks from Advanced AI
caveat: The taxonomy: 3 failure modes, 7 risk factors, 33 Table 1 instances, 13 Table 3 case studies, 12 FM-RF associations. Local copy at resources/multi-agent-risks.pdf.

name: Cooperative AI Foundation
caveat: Lessons from Recent Multi-Agent Safety Incidents surfaced GTG-1002, UK AISI Mythos 5 and Vending Bench Arena as multi-agent candidates; none is screened yet.

name: MIT AI Risk Repository
caveat: The repository uses subdomain 7.6, which the AIID classification export never does.

name: OWASP GenAI Security Project
caveat: ASI07 inter-agent communication and ASI08 cascading failures are usable cross-source tags.

name: MITRE ATLAS
caveat: Adversarial AI case studies.

name: Cloud Security Alliance Labs
caveat: Research notes on the Hugging Face swarm and on rogue-agent systemic risk.

name: OpenAI incident reports
caveat: Primary source for the Hugging Face incident technical report.

name: METR
caveat: METR / Redwood investigation of the Hugging Face incident; Sep 2026 Senate testimony.

name: UK AI Safety Institute
caveat: Incident report on unsanctioned agent behaviour during cyber testing. CAIF treats Mythos 5 as a multi-agent candidate; not yet screened.

name: Anthropic safety reporting
caveat: Incidents in cybersecurity evals. CAIF treats GTG-1002 as a multi-agent candidate; not yet screened.
